newsitem.title: USA: Omnicare to buy American Medserve.
newsitem.headline: Omnicare to buy American Medserve.

text.p: Omnicare Inc said Friday it has agreed to acquire American Medserve Corp for $18 per share in cash, representing a purchase price of about $222.6 million.
Additionally, Omnicare said, it will assume American Medserve's liabilities, including long-term debt of approximately $11.6 million.

Given the economies of scale and cost synergies anticipated from the merger, the acquisition of American Medserve is expected to be non-dilutive to Omnicare's earnings per share in 1997 and accretive in 1998, the company said.
Based on revenues reported for the quarter ended March 31, American Medserve Corp's annualized revenues are about $144.0 million.

The transaction, which has been approved by directors of both Omnicare and American Medserve, is subject to the tender of at least a majority of the outstanding American Medserve shares, customary regulatory approval and the satisfaction of certain other conditions.

The tender offer will start within five business days and will remain open for 20 business days, unless extended. Following the tender offer, Omnicare will acquire any of the remaining outstanding shares of American Medserve in a cash merger transaction valued at $18.00 per share.

With the completion of this acquisition, Omnicare said, it will provide pharmacy and related consulting services to some 413,000 residents in over 5,100 long-term care facilities in 35 states. Based on revenues for the quarter ended June 30, Omnicare's annualized revenues, following the transaction, will be in excess of $950.0 million.
The acquisition of American Medserve will mark Omnicare's entry into six new states and will broaden Omnicare's network of existing pharmacies in five other states.
